hunks.baseline: The red eyes blinked, almost tame. So even a C-rank Rare Monster—the terrifying Hobgoblin Great Warrior—could make a face like that.
hunks.sol: The red eyes blinked meekly. So even a C-rank Rare Monster—the terrifying Hobgoblin Great Warrior—could make a face like that.

hunks.baseline: *Why didn’t I realize it until now?*
hunks.sol: *How had I never noticed?*

hunks.baseline: With that passing thought, I shook the blood off the spearhead. At the same time—
hunks.sol: With that passing thought, I flicked the blood from my spearhead. At the same time—

hunks.baseline: Something heavy hit the ground. The Great Warrior saw what it was and, without meaning to, shuffled backward.
hunks.sol: Something heavy hit the ground. The Great Warrior saw what it was and instinctively shuffled backward.

hunks.baseline: Well, fair enough. Its right arm had been snipped clean off below the elbow.
hunks.sol: Well, fair enough. Its right arm had been severed clean below the elbow.

hunks.baseline: Jin Family’s Manoeuvre Technique. Yeah—I’d used that exact technique to drive in against its chest. The Great Warrior reflexively swung its right arm, but that space was already empty.
hunks.sol: The Jin Family’s Manoeuvre Technique. That was how I’d slipped inside its reach. The Great Warrior reflexively swung its right arm, but there was nothing left there.

hunks.baseline: I set the spearhead against the Great Warrior’s side and drove it upward in the same motion. Charged with internal energy, the blade split hard skin and muscle.
hunks.sol: I pressed the spearhead to the Great Warrior’s side and swept it upward. Charged with internal energy, the blade split its tough hide and muscle.

hunks.baseline: Both arms gone in an instant, the Hobgoblin Great Warrior bellowed, the sound smeared with rage and pain.
hunks.sol: Both arms gone in an instant, the Hobgoblin Great Warrior roared in rage and agony.

hunks.baseline: But I still couldn’t let my guard down. Even without arms, it was more than dangerous enough bare-handed.
hunks.sol: But I still couldn’t let my guard down. Even without its arms, it was more than dangerous enough with just its body.

hunks.baseline: “Yeah. Come on in.”
hunks.sol: “Yeah. Come on.”

hunks.baseline: Before I’d even finished, that massive frame charged.
hunks.sol: Before I’d even finished speaking, its massive frame charged.

hunks.baseline: As expected, this thing’s body was a weapon all by itself. True to being a monster, it had primitive senses and strength beyond any human.
hunks.sol: As expected, this thing’s entire body was a weapon. Like the monster it was, it possessed primal senses and strength far beyond any human’s.

hunks.baseline: Hooked claws grazed my forearm. A handful of flesh tore away, and blood poured out. Without flinching, I blocked the heel stomping down at the crown of my head.
hunks.sol: Its hooked claws grazed my forearm. A chunk of flesh tore away, and blood poured out. Without flinching, I blocked the heel coming down toward the crown of my head.

hunks.baseline: The ground under my feet started to sink.
hunks.sol: The ground beneath my feet began to sink.

hunks.baseline: I drew up every last bit of internal energy in my dantian. The force flooded into every limb. As the spear shaft slowly rose, the Great Warrior’s eyes wavered.
hunks.sol: I drew up every last bit of internal energy in my dantian. Power flooded through my entire body. As my spear shaft slowly rose, the Great Warrior’s eyes wavered.

hunks.baseline: If it had been whole from the start, maybe. After losing both arms, the Hobgoblin Great Warrior was no longer my match.
hunks.sol: If it had been whole from the start, maybe things would have been different. But after losing both arms, the Hobgoblin Great Warrior was no longer a match for me.

hunks.baseline: In the end, it was the one that backed off first. And from that point, the fight was as good as decided.
hunks.sol: In the end, it was the first to retreat. By then, the fight was as good as over.

hunks.baseline: I didn’t stop. I thrust the spear out.
hunks.sol: I pressed forward and thrust my spear.

hunks.baseline: The movements engraved in my body and head unfurled in a rush.
hunks.sol: The movements engraved into my body and mind unfolded in a rush.

hunks.baseline: Thrust. Cut. Block and strike with the shaft. Simple on their own, but the order and the angles made countless combinations.
hunks.sol: Thrust. Cut. Block and strike with the shaft. Each movement was simple by itself, but changing the order and position created countless combinations.

hunks.baseline: That was martial arts, as I defined it.
hunks.sol: That was my definition of martial arts.

hunks.baseline: Those hooked claws, hard as steel, were cut away. Every step it gave, a new wound opened and more blood spilled.
hunks.sol: The hooked claws, hard as steel, were sliced away. With every step it retreated, another wound opened and more blood spilled.

hunks.baseline: Then the Hobgoblin Great Warrior’s back hit the wall.
hunks.sol: Before long, the Hobgoblin Great Warrior’s back struck the wall.

hunks.baseline: A C-rank Rare Monster. This thing had seemed impossible to face, but those red eyes had already lost their will to fight a long time ago.
hunks.sol: A C-rank Rare Monster. This beast had once seemed impossible to defeat, but the will to fight had long since faded from its red eyes.

hunks.baseline: “Go. Now.”
hunks.sol: “Time to go.”

hunks.baseline: Ghk. With a death rattle, the hulking green body slid down the wall.
hunks.sol: Ghk. With a final death rattle, the hulking green body slid down the wall.

hunks.baseline: The System notification rang. I’d thought I’d never hear it or see it again…
hunks.sol: The System notification rang out. I’d thought I would never hear or see one again…

hunks.baseline: *A System, out of nowhere?*
hunks.sol: *The System, out of nowhere?*

hunks.baseline: I wasn’t the only one confused.
hunks.sol: But I wasn’t the only one confused.

hunks.baseline: Team Leader Choi had already taken care of the Priest. His pupils trembled like they’d been hit by an earthquake as he looked from me to the Great Warrior’s corpse and back.
hunks.sol: Team Leader Choi had already dealt with the Priest. His pupils shook as if an earthquake had struck them while his gaze darted between me and the Great Warrior’s corpse.

hunks.baseline: Yeah. I’d like to know that myself.
hunks.sol: Good question. I’d like to know that myself.

hunks.baseline: The cigarette in the government official’s mouth dropped.
hunks.sol: The cigarette dropped from the government official’s mouth.

hunks.baseline: He looked born to be a civil servant, and this was anything but good news for him. Sure enough, the way he looked us over was nothing but unease.
hunks.sol: He looked like a born civil servant, so this was anything but good news for him. Sure enough, he eyed us with naked unease.

hunks.baseline: Team Leader Choi gave the Priest’s staff a weary shake.
hunks.sol: Team Leader Choi wearily shook the Priest’s staff.

hunks.baseline: I kicked the Hobgoblin Great Warrior’s greatsword I’d been using like a walking stick. At the dull sound, the official turned.
hunks.sol: I kicked the Hobgoblin Great Warrior’s greatsword, which I’d been using as a walking stick. The official turned at the dull clang.

hunks.baseline: “Buy one, get one more. C-rank Rare. Hobgoblin Great Warrior.”
hunks.sol: “Buy one, get one free. C-rank Rare. Hobgoblin Great Warrior.”

hunks.baseline: I got the reaction. This had to at least make some kind of sense.
hunks.sol: I understood his reaction. None of this made any damn sense.

hunks.baseline: The official looked back and forth between us and the gear for a while, then finally nodded with a sad face.
hunks.sol: The official stared back and forth between us and the equipment for a long moment before finally nodding with a miserable expression.

hunks.baseline: Im Kkeokjeong had come to at some point. I was holding him up. He’d taken serious injuries—at least five broken bones.
hunks.sol: Im Kkeokjeong had regained consciousness at some point. I was holding him upright, and he had suffered serious injuries, including at least five broken bones.

hunks.baseline: “Call a healer. A pretty unnie.”
hunks.sol: “Call us a healer. A pretty one.”

hunks.baseline: The E-rank trio dropped onto the ground as well.
hunks.sol: The E-rank trio collapsed onto the ground as well.

hunks.baseline: “And potions! Potions! The good stuff!”
hunks.sol: “And potions! Potions! Bring out the good stuff!”

hunks.baseline: “Ah, for fuck’s sake, how did you people even manage this Gate?!”
hunks.sol: “Ah, for fuck’s sake! How did you people manage this Gate?”

hunks.baseline: “Our gear’s all smashed too, huh? What are you going to do about this?!”
hunks.sol: “All our gear’s smashed too! Huh? What are you going to do about that?”

hunks.baseline: Do about it? The government would cover everything.
hunks.sol: What did they think? The government would compensate them for everything.

hunks.baseline: There was an actual law for this: every item used in the Gate, plus medical costs and compensation.
hunks.sol: There was an actual law covering situations like this. Every item consumed inside the Gate, along with medical bills and additional compensation, would be paid for.

hunks.baseline: So it was a show. Squeeze out a little extra.
hunks.sol: In other words, this was all an act to squeeze out a little more.

hunks.baseline: *Tsk. Even so. People are watching.*
hunks.sol: *Tsk, tsk. Even so, people are watching.*

hunks.baseline: That was when I felt a stinging look from beside me.
hunks.sol: Just then, I felt a piercing gaze from beside me.

hunks.baseline: Team Leader Choi.
hunks.sol: It was Team Leader Choi.

hunks.baseline: He was looking at me, confused. More precisely, at the hand holding my dagger.
hunks.sol: He stared at me in confusion. More precisely, at the hand holding my dagger.

hunks.baseline: Grrrk.
hunks.sol: Scrape.

hunks.baseline: The dagger, charged with internal energy, raked long lines through seven-year leather armor until it was too wrecked to use.
hunks.sol: Charged with internal energy, the dagger carved long gashes through my seven-year-old leather armor, ruining it beyond repair.

hunks.baseline: I sighed hard enough to cave in the ground.
hunks.sol: I sighed heavily enough to sink the ground.

hunks.baseline: “The Hobgoblin Great Warrior. It was really strong. I made it out alive, but every piece of gear I had is ruined.”
hunks.sol: “That Hobgoblin Great Warrior was incredibly strong. I escaped with my life, but every piece of equipment I owned was destroyed.”

hunks.baseline: “The armor that protected me for seven years. And now even the spear.”
hunks.sol: “The armor that protected me for seven years—and now even my spear.”

hunks.baseline: Right then, I pressed down steadily on the middle of the spear with one foot.
hunks.sol: At that moment, I planted one foot on the middle of the spear and slowly pressed down.

hunks.baseline: Under the majesty of a three-digit Strength stat, the iron spear bent like a stick of taffy.
hunks.sol: Before the majesty of my three-digit Strength stat, the iron spear bent like taffy.

hunks.baseline: “Looks perfectly fine? This?”
hunks.sol: “Perfectly fine? This does?”

hunks.baseline: Team Leader Choi shut his mouth.
hunks.sol: Team Leader Choi closed his mouth.

hunks.baseline: Team Leader Choi was called away by the officials dispatched to take charge, and the other four were moved to an ambulance for treatment.
hunks.sol: Team Leader Choi was called away by the officials dispatched to take charge, while the other four were loaded into an ambulance for treatment.

hunks.baseline: Instead of the musty break room, I was left alone in a wide, comfortable office. Now that the moment had actually come, my heart started pounding.
hunks.sol: Instead of the musty break room, I was left alone in a spacious, comfortable office. Now that the moment had finally arrived, my heart began to pound.

hunks.baseline: At that half-doubtful call, the System answered.
hunks.sol: The System answered my doubtful call.

hunks.baseline: “Fuck. It really came up.”
hunks.sol: “Fuck. It really showed up.”

hunks.baseline: I stared at the Status Window, blank, then noticed something off.
hunks.sol: I stared blankly at the Status Window for a moment before noticing something strange.

hunks.baseline: The first things that jumped out were Fame reset to zero and two missing Titles. The last line gave me a rough idea why.
hunks.sol: The first things that stood out were my Fame resetting to zero and two missing Titles. The final line gave me a pretty good idea why.

hunks.baseline: All five hundred Fame I’d stacked had been earned as a martial artist in Murim. The Title that had vanished, *Scion of a Prestigious Family*, made sense the same way.
hunks.sol: All five hundred points of Fame I’d accumulated had been earned as a martial artist in Murim. The missing Title *Scion of a Prestigious Family* made sense for the same reason.

hunks.baseline: *Well, I’m not some prestigious family’s son here. And I’m sure as hell no Sleeping Dragon.*
hunks.sol: *Well, I’m not the son of some prestigious family here. And I’m definitely no Sleeping Dragon.*

hunks.baseline: If I were getting a Title here, it’d obviously be something like *Scion of the Common Folk*, or *Earthworm* instead of Sleeping Dragon.
hunks.sol: If I earned a Title here, it would probably be something like *Scion of the Common Folk*. Or *Earthworm* instead of Sleeping Dragon.

hunks.baseline: “How much else changed?”
hunks.sol: “What else changed?”

hunks.baseline: For about ten minutes I turned every System function on and off and tested them. The only thing that had changed was the Status Window.
hunks.sol: For the next ten minutes or so, I opened, closed, and tested every System function one by one. The Status Window was the only thing that had changed.

hunks.baseline: No. There was one more. The Quest Window.
hunks.sol: No—there was one more.

hunks.sol: The Quest Window.

hunks.baseline: The Chain Quest I’d gotten after taking down Gwak Jun and the assassins. My thoughts tangled.
hunks.sol: It was the Chain Quest I’d received after killing Gwak Jun and the assassins. My thoughts grew tangled.

hunks.baseline: *Go back? To Murim?*
hunks.sol: *Does it want me to go back? To Murim?*

hunks.baseline: I knew it now. The Murim I’d been through wasn’t an illusion, and it wasn’t a game. A wildly unrealistic story, sure, but Murim was probably…
hunks.sol: I knew now. The Murim I’d experienced wasn’t an illusion or a game. It sounded utterly impossible, but Murim was probably…

hunks.baseline: I turned at the sudden sound. Team Leader Choi was standing in the doorway.
hunks.sol: I turned at the sudden sound. Team Leader Choi stood in the doorway.

hunks.baseline: Looked like the talk had wrapped up. I folded the thought away and stood.
hunks.sol: It looked like the discussion had wrapped up. I put the thought aside and rose.

hunks.baseline: “They should be on their way to the hospital by now. They said about a week of admission. You don’t need to worry.”
hunks.sol: “They should be on their way to the hospital by now. They’ll need to stay for about a week. You don’t need to worry.”

hunks.baseline: I wasn’t particularly worried. Combat-type Hunter bodies, plus potions and healing magic—they’d be up soon enough.
hunks.sol: I wasn’t particularly worried. They had the sturdy bodies of combat-type Hunters, not to mention potions and healing magic. They would be back on their feet soon enough.

hunks.baseline: “They’ll contact us again in a few days. An investigator will probably come see you, too.”
hunks.sol: “They’ll contact us again in a few days. An investigator will probably visit you as well.”

hunks.baseline: Not a type I wanted to run into again. But that wasn’t the answer I’d wanted, so I asked again.
hunks.sol: Not the sort of person I wanted to deal with again. But that wasn’t the answer I wanted, so I asked once more.

hunks.baseline: “And the rest?”
hunks.sol: “What about the other thing?”

hunks.baseline: Team Leader Choi looked at me with an odd expression. Like he was studying some strange animal.
hunks.sol: Team Leader Choi regarded me with an odd expression, as though he were studying some fascinating animal.

hunks.baseline: I didn’t want my strength out in the open. Even less now, when I still barely knew why the System was showing up in reality, or what it had to do with Murim.
hunks.sol: I didn’t want my strength becoming public knowledge. Especially now, when I still had no idea why I could see the System in reality or how it was connected to Murim.

hunks.baseline: An F-rank Hunter killing a C-rank Rare Monster alone was unheard of. An awl in a bag pokes through. I’d lived the opposite kind of life, nothing sticking out, so I had to be careful.
hunks.sol: An F-rank Hunter defeating a C-rank Rare Monster alone was unprecedented. An awl hidden in a sack would always poke through, but I’d spent my whole life being the exact opposite. I couldn’t help being cautious.

hunks.baseline: So I asked him.
hunks.sol: So I’d asked him:

hunks.baseline: “Could you keep what concerns me a secret?”
hunks.sol: “Could you keep what happened with me a secret?”

hunks.baseline: From Team Leader Choi’s side, it had to be a hard ask. I was telling him to lie in his statement for someone he’d only just met.
hunks.sol: It must have been a difficult request for Team Leader Choi. I was asking him to give a false statement for someone he’d only just met.

hunks.baseline: His heavy voice made my chest sink with it—and then:
hunks.sol: His grave voice made my heart sink.
Then—

hunks.baseline: “Let’s get some food.”
hunks.sol: “Let’s get something to eat.”

hunks.baseline: Team Leader Choi held out his wrist. A glittering Magic Gem electronic watch pointed to two in the afternoon.
hunks.sol: Team Leader Choi held out his wrist. A glittering Magic Gem digital watch showed two in the afternoon.

hunks.baseline: “It’s an N Company piece carved from a whole C-rank Magic Gem. It’s got enhancement magic, so in an emergency you can even use it as a shield—”
hunks.sol: “It’s an N Company model carved from a whole C-rank Magic Gem. It’s enchanted with enhancement magic, so in an emergency, you can even use it as a shield—”

hunks.baseline: Impossible man to read.
hunks.sol: The man was impossible to read.

hunks.baseline: “Let’s get some meat. You like Hanwoo?[^1]”
hunks.sol: “Let’s get some meat. Do you like Hanwoo?[^1]”

hunks.baseline: And rich, too.
hunks.sol: And he was rich.

hunks.baseline: “I never get to eat it.”
hunks.sol: “I can never get enough of it.”

hunks.baseline: Not just any beef. Hanwoo. Top-grade Hanwoo at that.
hunks.sol: This wasn’t just any beef. It was Hanwoo. Top-grade Hanwoo at that.

hunks.baseline: System or whatever—first I had to fill a hungry stomach.
hunks.sol: System or whatever—to hell with it. First, I needed to fill my empty stomach.
